summary: All 4 Round 1 findings are resolved cleanly and no regressions were introduced. (1) i18n labels are now pinned via text() assertions against the spy-returned keys — a hardcoded literal regression fails. (2) Symmetric /en General-active case added, mirroring the existing /en Bot-active case; a regex regression on either branch is caught. (3) bot.spec now asserts the rendered General href is /projects/p1/settings, so dropping the :project-id binding collapses the href and fails the test. (4) Component emits aria-current="page" and tests assert it as the primary behavioural contract, with the Tailwind class kept only as a secondary CSS-regression signal — refactoring the class no longer forces a test rewrite. Bonus: localePathSpy assertion makes the useLocalePath dependency explicit and survives the identity-mock constraint documented in-file. Litmus test passes on every assertion. Pyramid balance unchanged (unit-only, appropriate for a presentational component). Reviewer confirms all 203 vitest tests pass.
